author: David W.
title: good system but has a learning curve
body: Overall I'm happy with this purchase but it definitely took some getting used to. The quality is good - hair looks and feels natural, color matched perfectly. However, the application process is not as straightforward as the videos make it seem. First attempt was a disaster with air bubbles and uneven placement. Had to remove it and start over. Second time was better. By the third application I had it down. Been wearing for about 2 months now and it's holding up well. Gets a bit warm in the summer which is my only real complaint. For the price point it's a solid choice, just be prepared for some trial and error at the beginning.

title: best hair system i've tried in 5 years
body: I've been wearing hair systems since 2018 and this is hands down the best quality I've found. The hairline is undetectable - even my barber was impressed. Application took some practice at first (watch the tutorial videos!), but now I can do it in about 20 minutes. Been wearing this unit for 2.5 months and it still looks great. Definitely worth the investment and I'll be ordering another one soon.
